info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Favorites-v5-spec
info.description: The Favorite Real Estate Listings API allows users to access a curated list of their preferred real estate properties. This endpoint is designed for users looking to quickly retrieve information about properties they have saved as favorites. Typical consumers include real estate agents, property seekers, and investors who wish to efficiently manage their listings. By utilizing this API, clients can enhance user experience through personalized property discovery.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of all their favorite listings. It provides an easy way to access and manage favorite properties.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the necessary parameters for retrieving the favorite listings. The expected format is in JSON, containing relevant information that the server will process to return the user's favorite listings.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of favorite listings.
